# Airial

> > AI-powered travel planner that creates personalized itineraries from TikTok videos, Instagram posts, Reddit recommendations, and user prompts.

Airial aggregates travel inspiration from social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit to generate custom travel itineraries. The platform features destination guides, attraction recommendations, and a blog focused on European travel and hidden gems.

## Key Topics

- AI travel planning
- Personalized itineraries
- TikTok travel content
- Instagram travel inspiration
- Reddit travel recommendations
- Automated itinerary generation
- Lisbon attractions and tours
- European destinations
- Food tours and culinary experiences
- Family-friendly activities
- Medieval fortifications and historical landmarks
- Photography tips for travelers
- Hidden gems and local experiences

## AI Travel Planning

- [Airial | AI Travel Planner](https://alpha.airial.travel/): AI travel planner creating personalized itineraries from TikToks or prompts

## Travel Blog & Guides

- [Airial Blog - Built for Curious Travelers. Powered by Airial.](https://airial.travel/blog/): Travel blog covering Europe destinations, itineraries, and hidden gems

## Attraction Guides

- [Medieval City Walls and Towers (2026) – Best of TikTok, Instagram & Reddit Travel Guide](https://airial.travel/attractions/poland/toruń/medieval-city-walls-and-towers-hOHqJdHI): Travel guide for Toruń's Medieval City Walls featuring The Leaning Tower
- [Zolotaya Bukhta Water Park (2026) – Best of TikTok, Instagram & Reddit Travel Guide](https://airial.travel/attractions/russia/gelendzhik/zolotaya-bukhta-water-park-kV5vzxg0): Guide to Russia's premier water park in Gelendzhik with slides & pools
- [Atwater Community Park (2026) – Best of TikTok, Instagram & Reddit Travel Guide](https://airial.travel/attractions/united-states/north-port/atwater-community-park-3Vh_xXeE): Guide to North Port, Florida's family-friendly park with splash pad
